description: Find step-by-step instructions for a common job, written for you to follow with these tools: cutting the pauses, ums and restarts out of a talking video, for one. Search in the user's words; every skill comes back best first with its score (roughly 0 to 1). Below 0.1 is unrelated; a real fit usually scores 0.15 to 0.45, lower for a short or general ask, and an unrelated skill that shares words can score as high, so read the description of each one above 0.1 to judge the fit. Read one with skills.get, then follow its Steps.

limit.description: Most matches to return, best first

query.description: What the user wants done, in their words, e.g. "remove the ums from my video"

name: skills.search

skills.description: Best first; empty when nothing fits

score.description: Roughly 0 to 1, higher is closer; below 0.1 is unrelated, above it read the description

title: Find a skill
